desc: The HARVESTER Slug Gun returns as a perfect fusion of time-tested power and modern ergonomics - now with a completely redesigned AccuFit V2 adjustable stock that lets any shooter dial in a custom fit in seconds. Built on the platform's hard-hitting legacy, the new stock offers tool-less length-of-pull and comb height adjustments, modular recoil mitigation, and refined cheek weld geometry so the gun points naturally and shoots flatter from bench to blind. The HARVESTER's enhanced fit and balance unlock crisper follow-through, reduced felt recoil, and confidence shot after shot.
